title: refactor: single model-catalog hook for the permissions picker
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Split out of #13464 — no behaviour change.

- `authorize.tsx` and `account-permissions-input.tsx` each ran the same `fetchModelCatalog` effect, and both render on the authorize screen at once. Extracted into `useModelCategories()`.
- `AccountPermissionsInput` now takes `modelCategories` as a prop, so the grant summary above the picker and the checkbox list render from one array instead of two independent fetches.
- Fixes three dead Scalar anchors: `#tag/bring-your-own-pollen` → `#tag/byop` (the tag is `byop`; `dashboard-shell.tsx` already links it correctly).

Two call sites updated; `key-permissions.tsx` calls the hook itself.

gist.headline: One catalog, one hive mind
gist.blurb: The permissions picker stopped asking the garden the same question twice. One shared catalog now keeps grant summaries and checkbox lists neatly in sync, while a few lost documentation links found their way home.
gist.summary: Extracted a shared useModelCategories() hook so the authorize screen fetches the model catalog once for both its grant summary and permissions picker, and corrected three BYOP Scalar anchors from #tag/bring-your-own-pollen to #tag/byop.
gist.impact: Authorization and API-key permission screens now render their model categories from one consistent catalog response, with working links to the BYOP API documentation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy permissions garden where one central model-catalog plant sends tidy vines to both a grant-summary sign and a checkbox-picker board, rather than two separate plants doing the same work. Polli acts as the observant gardener, carrying a tiny clipboard and connecting the shared vine; small signposts labeled BYOP point correctly toward a welcoming documentation nook.
